How an AIdeate session runs

01

Come prepared

The host brings use cases for the customer's industry, so the room starts with examples.

02

Ideate

The team adds its own problems in plain words, live on the shared screen.

03

Vote

Everyone votes on what matters most. The ranking updates as they do.

04

Results

A ranked list and one clear first use case to prove.
